paper_metadata.title: Profile of First Time Seizure in Infants with 1 to 12 Months of Age Presenting to a Tertiary Care Pediatric Hospital

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study provides a clear description of the recruitment setting, period, and inclusion/exclusion criteria. However, the sample size is small (n=50) and represents a tertiary care population, which may introduce selection bias toward more severe cases compared to the general infant population.

items.reasoning: While recruitment was consecutive, the study is limited to a single tertiary center, which may not represent the broader community.

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: While imaging and EEG are objective, the timing of EEG was delayed (2 weeks), which the authors admit may have affected results. Additionally, the classification of 'abnormal' was broad and not detailed.
